description: Offline website mirroring with HTTrack — snapshot one page (with its assets) or mirror a bounded site to disk for offline reading, backup, or research. Provides scripted recipes (doctor/snapshot/mirror) with polite defaults (robots=always, 2 sockets, depth-limited), strict URL validation, resumable mirrors, and stable JSON reports for agents.
